$note: Rosso Corsa palette (v2). Source of truth for the website: app/globals.css and lib/colors.ts in the landing-page repo. The previous amber palette is archived in tokens/archive/.

bg.role: Off-white base with a faint cool tint. Main light surface.

ink.role: Primary text and the dark full-bleed sections. Blue-black, not pure black.

ink-soft.role: Dark grey-blue panels and cards on ink.

muted.role: Secondary text and captions, on dark surfaces only.

muted-strong.role: Secondary text on the off-white base.

accent.role: Rosso Corsa signal red. The one loud colour: highlights, the mark, key words, buttons, blobs, the 3D hero object. A fill on light surfaces; text/lines only on ink.

accent-deep.role: Deeper red for hover/active states, depth and gradients (red to deep red, 135 degrees).

steel.role: Cool support colour on light surfaces: tags, thin lines, timeline dots, secondary buttons. Structure and data, never decoration.

steel-light.role: The same support colour for dark surfaces.

mist.role: Cool tint for cards and panels on light surfaces.

contrast.use: red text, numbers and marks on dark: OK
ink text and numbers on a red fill: OK
red numerals on dark cards: OK (just)
off-white on red: do not use for small text
off-white text on a steel fill
focus outline and large graphics on light (needs 3:1)
FAILS for small text. Red on light is a FILL, or very large display type only.
too close to separate two shapes on their own

rules: Red is text/line colour only on ink or ink-soft. On light surfaces red is a fill, with ink on top (5.3:1).
Light theme with full-bleed ink sections for rhythm. Neutrals are tinted toward the brand's cool hue, never pure grey.
Red is sparing. Guideline for liveries: about 70-80% off-white/ink/steel, up to roughly 20% red, deep red a few percent at most.
Steel is a support colour: structure, data, thin lines, secondary panels. It never competes with red.
Do not introduce new hues. Use only the tokens above.
